parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A small rubber wheel attached to the bottom of the shopping cart for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: Allows the cart to roll smoothly across the floor, supporting the cart’s movement.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates freely around its axle and swivels for directional control.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A small rubber wheel located at one corner of the cart’s base.
parts.Functional_description: Provides rolling support and stability to the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates and swivels to enable smooth directional changes.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel forming part of the cart’s four-wheel system.
parts.Functional_description: Ensures even weight distribution and smooth rolling motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates and swivels to assist in maneuvering the cart.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel attached to the base frame of the cart.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the cart’s load and enables movement.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates and swivels to facilitate steering and rolling.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: A plastic handlebar located at the top rear of the cart.
parts.Functional_description: Used by the user to push, pull, and steer the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed to the frame; does not move independently but transmits force to the cart body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main steel frame and basket structure of the shopping cart.
parts.Functional_description: Holds items placed by the user and provides structural integrity to the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Rigid and stationary; supports all other parts including wheels and handle.
